facts.fact: 前一晚是为 Armen 庆祝生日，Soren 说这是让酒局失控的唯一原因。
facts.anchor: Last night was to celebrate Armen’s birthday. That’s the only reason I let the evening get as messy as it did.

facts.fact: Soren 换衣服时选了深红色衬衫，说自己从不穿亮色。
facts.anchor: I leave them unfastened for now and reach for a shirt. Dark red, not bright, I never wear bright colours

facts.fact: 早餐时 Soren 与 Ray 约定先从北区车行开始跑业务。
facts.anchor: “We’ll start at the north-side dealership first,” I tell him, cutting into my food.

facts.fact: Lorraine 告诉 Soren 早餐还要二十分钟。
facts.anchor: “Breakfast will be another twenty minutes, boss.”

facts.fact: Soren 在厨房岛台找到缺席早餐的 Kit，他正缩着尽量不挡别人的路。
facts.anchor: And there, at the island, is Kit. He’s looking small and carefully out of everyone’s way

facts.fact: Soren 抓住 Kit 的腰，把他从高脚凳上整个人提起来放到地上。
facts.anchor: I straighten, grab him by the waist, and lift him clean off the stool, setting him on his feet on the floor.

facts.fact: Soren 当众宣布谁都不准坐在 Christopher 旁边、不准打扰他。
facts.anchor: “Not anymore. No one sits next to Christopher. Leave him alone.” I raise my voice just enough for the whole table to hear.

facts.fact: Soren 发现 Kit 偷看他，一对上视线 Kit 立刻脸红低头。
facts.anchor: They stop when they lock straight onto Kit’s; his eyes go wide the instant he’s caught.
